named_retained_host: The fixed reviewed G19 support, with all original 19 points retained and its unrestricted full four-colour relation
driver: Every point outside G19 at unit distance from at least three distinct G19 points, added simultaneously; include every unit contact among all merged points. No iterative closure.
exact_generation: Enumerate the 969 nonrepeated triples, omit collinear triples, keep circumradius exactly one, and compute their unique circumcentres in the original degree-eight field. Merge all collisions and old points.
budget_proof: Each new centre has at least three pairs of old unit neighbours. Each old pair has at most two unit-circle centres. Hence there are at most 2*C(19,2)/3=114 such centres in all, and at most 19+114=133 union points.
intended_blocker: Under the already-published G19 four-colouring, each new vertex has at least three old neighbours; three distinct neighbour colours force its remaining colour. New-to-new unit contacts could obstruct these simultaneous lists. This is a hypothesis to test, not an assumed chromatic gain.
admission_gate: Reconstruct the complete exact support, then test extension of this known host word. A checked extension is already a nonempty unrestricted actual host/driver relation intersection and retires the entire frozen one-step driver.
positive_gate: If the known word fails, immediately test ordinary four-colourability on the same complete <=133 support; a four-colouring stops. Non-four signal plus a checked proper five-colouring would give a direct capped candidate, with replayable non-four certification next.
no_variants: No second layer, two-neighbour completion, source substitution, phase/copy/host sweep or continuation of I450/F29.
